title: This is my Android Game: Project Avalanche
author: Acidsstudio
selftext:
Hey,

I wanted to share my Android game: Project Avalanche.

I mostly used Opus 5.5 and a bit of Fable 5.2 for the animations.  
The models were created with Meshy.  
My workflow was Opus doing the basic game, Astra did some artwork and HUD recommendations, and Fable refined the animations.  
The biggest struggle was probably the animations and glitching through the boards. They are still not perfect but are somewhat better than they were with Opus 5.5.  
I did try Mixamo and stuff, but it just didn’t work at all. Sounds are from a Humble Bundle I bought, and some are from Claude itself.

I’d love for you to check it out and play it. Idc about the money, play it in airplane mode. Should work fine. Ads are every 2 levels as of now.

It made exactly 0 cents and was released about a week ago.

If you have any feedback, I’d love to hear it.

Btw, the trailer was entirely made with Opus 5.5 (with the prompt “make a cool self promotion video with the core features for reddit”, and I think it did a great job).
